option_relations.rationale: Coccidioides meningitis is a fungal infection, while Cysticercosis is a parasitic infection. They are distinct etiologies.
Lymphocytic meningitis of unknown etiology is a general description of a type of meningitis without a specified cause. Cysticercosis is a specific parasitic infection with a known etiology.
Bacterial meningitis is caused by bacteria. Cysticercosis is caused by a parasite (Taenia solium).
Coccidioidomycosis is a fungal infection. Cysticercosis is a parasitic infection. They are distinct diseases with different etiologies.
